summary: Isolate test configuration and fail on invalid fixture setup. The change edits test files only in internal/configuration, internal/diff, internal/exclusion, internal/report, internal/engine, and internal/engine/workdir. Tests that change the shared configuration reset it and register the reset before the change. Engine fixture reads use readFixture, which fails the calling test on a read error and keeps no file open. notWriteableDir and the workdir TestErrors permission cases check setup errors, register the permission restore first, and probe for a permission error. The repairs remove existing lint findings, so make lint-shrink removes their entries from .lint/baseline.json. The baseline only shrinks. docs/development/test-assessment.md records the G04, G05, and G09 repairs. No production code, internal dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: The tests run locally and in existing CI. They start no network call and run no scanned source. The change keeps the development-check, delivery-finalization, and merge-queue-policy boundaries unchanged.
